notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
The AI difficulty in campaign mode is reduced, specifically for ranks aimed at beginners

God of Gamblers ： 0~6 - > Each time it refreshes, the cost of the store's legion randomly changes (1~5)
Neutral Commander :  End of turn: neutral units +2 Amount and neutral heroes +2 Enhance
Archangel ：When a purchased legion matches one of the same gold legions on the field, it is destroyed, and the Amount of gold legions + 5 (hero units included) and Gain +2 gold
Smithing Sorceress: Health 600 → 800, Attack Speed 0.25 → 0.4
Siege artillery: Health 250→ 500,  tower Attack Speed 0.4 → 0.8

notes.title: Game Update: Brand-New Commander Heroes
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your support. Based on the feedback and suggestions received on Discord, the new patch has optimized some aspects of the game experience. We hope this game can continue to grow and improve together with you

[h3]New Content Added
[/h3]1 : Adding 3 new commander heroes 
[img]https://clan.cdn.queniuqe.com/images/45006606/7ab11e7ee8e84d89b84b001a8d978b233e249041.png[/img]
Neutral Commander
skill : End of turn: Amount of neutral units +2
[img]https://clan.cdn.queniuqe.com/images/45006606/8a08df7de978e35fd7e3fe55fee3de224f3363ac.png[/img]
God of Gamblers
skill : Each time it refreshes, the cost of the store's legion randomly changes (0~6)
[img]https://clan.cdn.queniuqe.com/images/45006606/5901bc56299590678f6ed71806ec36dfca981083.png[/img]
Archangel
skill : When a purchased legion matches one of the same gold legions on the field, it is destroyed, and the Amount of gold legions + 10 (hero units included)
2 : campaign Mode: Spend gold to select and experience heroes of your choice

[h3]Suggested Improvements
[/h3]1 : Reducing respawn time from 20 to 6 
2 : Modifying some translation descriptions 

[h3]Balance Update
[/h3]1 : Weakening the frequency of money acquisition for slave master from 10 to 6
2 : Falconer- (slave gain) +2 -> +1
3 : Iron Pagoda - (half the stun time) 2s -> 1s
4 : Nerf the Centurion's attributes
5 : General Nicholas - (Increased movement speed)
6 : Reduce the damage of the stone-throwing skill

notes.title: Warlords of the Deck Early Access Release
notes.notes:
New Content:
[list]
[*]     Camtain Mode 
                      You can enter challenge mode after 10 victories, completing an additional 3 levels.
[/list]   
[list]
[*]     27 New Hero Commanders Added
                      More gameplay mechanics, richer combinations and strategies.
[/list]
[list]
[*]     New Game Mode: Duo
                     Supports 2v2 team mode.
                     Teammates can combine and utilize each other's different hero commanders.
                     Armies from one teammate can reach the other teammate's battlefield to help achieve victory.
                     Victorious teammates can earn additional spell card rewards.
[/list]

We welcome you to experience the new gameplay. If you have any suggestions, feel free to share them on Discord.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45006606/4eb0bf6b660b24670d52316cb7107114153f97d2.png[/img]

notes.title: The Warlords of the Deck 6.20 demo version is about to end and will be closed.
notes.notes:
We extend our deepest gratitude for your participation in the trial run of the demo version of our game. Your valuable feedback has been instrumental in shaping our upcoming official release.

We are excited to announce that we have prepared an array of new and enhanced features for the official version, soon to be made available for download. Your continued support would mean a great deal to us.

As an independent game developer, I have dedicated two years to bringing this project to fruition. The journey has been challenging, but with your encouragement and input, we have been able to make remarkable progress. Rest assured, we are committed to ongoing updates and optimizations in the future.

Once again, thank you for being a part of this journey, and we look forward to your continued support in our upcoming endeavor.
